description: This is a Streamlit-based Python source file for a web page that allows users to upload PDF files of medical textbook chapters, process them by extracting text, generating embeddings, and storing them in a vector database. It also displays existing chapters and provides options to delete them with confirmation prompts.

classes.name: LangchainPDFProcessor
classes.description: A class responsible for processing PDF files to extract text chunks.

classes.name: EmbeddingManager
classes.description: A class managing the creation of text embeddings, including batch embedding.

classes.name: LocalVectorStore
classes.description: A class for managing storage and retrieval of embeddings in a local vector database.

methods.name: process_pdf
methods.description: Method of LangchainPDFProcessor that processes a PDF file and returns text chunks.

methods.name: batch_embed
methods.description: Method of EmbeddingManager that generates embeddings for a batch of texts asynchronously.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Method of LocalVectorStore to load existing embeddings from storage.

methods.name: add_embeddings
methods.description: Method of LocalVectorStore to add new embeddings and associated chunks.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Method of LocalVectorStore to save the current state of embeddings.
